title: 第17章 震惊的陈医师第18章 成为陈医师助手
slug: 有熟练度面板的我学什么都快
content_zh:
时间匆匆而过，两周很快过去。
今天天空澄碧，阳光温暖，几片白云在天空飘荡，像大海里浮动的白帆。
林潜正朝着炼药堂走去，今天是陈药师考核他们几个学徒记忆药材进度的日子。
一旦成功那就离药师更近一步了，林潜自然不会错过这次机会。
调出灰色熟练度面板，林潜看了看这段时间武技的进度。
姓名：林潜
职业：医师（一阶82%）。
寿命：1570。
境界：淬体境--易筋。
武技：通臂拳（三阶64%）、无影针（一阶10%）。
医师快突破到二阶了，通臂拳再有一个月就到锻骨了。
据他了解，和他同一批进入外门的弟子zhong，目前还没有人突破到易筋。
这两周时间里，林潜并没有花太多时间来修炼无影针，只是偶尔放松时，才拿出银针练练。
因为林潜一直待在门内，又不外出，对无影针的修炼就没那么紧迫。
林潜这段时间全部用来修炼通臂拳和刷医师熟练度了。
早晨修炼两小时通臂拳，接着看医书。
午饭后，看两个小时医书，然后服用强筋散，修炼通臂拳。
晚上点着油灯，在昏黄的房间里继续刷医书。
过的日子比前世996的上班族还要规律忙碌，并且全周无休。
不过林潜并不觉得枯燥、疲惫。

自从修炼通臂拳后，他感觉自己龙精虎猛，精神抖擞，完全没有前世下班回到家就倒在床上的疲惫感。
再加上熟练度肉眼可见的提升，林潜只感觉成就感爆棚，行动力也就越强。
他还畅想的去看看外面更大的世界，来一次波澜壮阔的旅程。
......
林潜到药堂院子里时，张平和张修已经到了。
只是让林潜诧异的是，两人各站一边，谁也不搭理谁。
看到林潜来了，两人向林潜问了好，林潜微微点头回应。
林潜本就不是话多之人，看着两人都没有交谈的意思，他也不再说话，安静等待陈医师到来。
只是林潜发现张修神色紧张，惴惴不安，而张平眼睛带着兴奋、热切，给人一直迫不及待的感觉。
没多久，身穿青色长衫的陈医师走了进来。
“见过陈医师！”
看着陈医师到来，林潜三人都对着陈医师恭敬的行礼。
“好，都来齐了，准备考核吧。”
看着三人，陈医师不紧不慢的开口道。
陈医师指着一个人说道。
“你们一个一个来，就先从你开始吧。”
说完，陈医师就走进一个房间内，而被点名的张修一脸苦色的跟着陈医师进入房间。
大概一盏茶的时间，张修就出来了，脸色苍白，额头上还有着汗珠，看来考核成绩并不理想。
“下一个！”
房间里传来陈医师苍老温和的声音。

“林师兄，不知是你先去还是我先去。”
content_en:
Time flies by and two weeks pass quickly.
Today the sky is clear and blue, the sun is warm, and a few white clouds are floating in the sky, like white sails floating in the sea.
Lin Qian was walking towards the medicine refining hall. Today was the day for Pharmacist Chen to assess the progress of several of his apprentices in memorizing medicinal materials.
Once he succeeds, he will be one step closer to becoming a pharmacist. Lin Qian will naturally not miss this opportunity.
Pulling up the gray proficiency panel, Lin Qian looked at the progress of his martial arts during this period.
Name: Lin Qian
Occupation: Physician (1st level 82%).
Lifespan: 1570.
Realm: Tempering Body Realm - Yijin.
Martial skills: Arm-Through Fist (3rd level 64%), Shadowless Needle (1st level 10%).
The doctor is about to break through to the second level, and the Tongjiquan will reach the bone forging level in another month.
According to his understanding, among the disciples who entered the outer sect in the same group as him, no one has yet broken through to Yi Jin.
In the past two weeks, Lin Qian did not spend much time practicing the Shadowless Needle. He only took out the silver needle to practice occasionally when he relaxed.
Because Lin Qian stayed inside the door and didn't go out, the practice of Shadowless Needle was not so urgent.
Lin Qian spent all this time practicing Tongjiquan and improving his doctor proficiency.
In the morning, I practiced Tongjiquan for two hours, and then read medical books.
After lunch, I read medical books for two hours, then took Qiangjin Powder and practiced Tongjiquan.
At night, I lit an oil lamp and continued to brush up on medical books in the dim room.
The days I lead are busier and busier than those of 996 office workers in my previous life, and they have no days off throughout the week.
But Lin Qian didn't feel bored or tired.
Since practicing Tongjiquan, he feels that he is energetic and vigorous, without the fatigue that he felt when he came home from get off work and fell into bed in his previous life.
Coupled with the visible improvement in proficiency, Lin Qian felt an overwhelming sense of accomplishment and became stronger in action.
He also wanted to see the bigger world outside and have a magnificent journey.
...
When Lin sneaked into the courtyard of the medicine hall, Zhang Ping and Zhang Xiu had already arrived.
What surprised Lin Qian was that the two of them stood on different sides and ignored each other.
Seeing Lin Qian coming, the two of them said hello to Lin Qian, who nodded slightly in response.
Lin Qian was not a talkative person. Seeing that neither of them had the intention to talk, he stopped talking and quietly waited for Dr. Chen to arrive.
But Lin Qian found that Zhang Xiu looked nervous and uneasy, while Zhang Ping's eyes were excited and eager, giving people the feeling of being impatient.
Not long after, Dr. Chen, wearing a green gown, walked in.
"I've met Dr. Chen!"
Seeing Dr. Chen arrive, Lin Qian and the other two people all saluted Dr. Chen respectfully.
"Okay, we're all here, get ready for the assessment."
Looking at the three of them, Dr. Chen spoke slowly.
Dr. Chen pointed at a person and said.
"You come one by one, let's start with you."
After saying that, Dr. Chen walked into a room, and Zhang Xiu, who was named, followed Dr. Chen into the room with a bitter look on his face.
After about a cup of tea, Zhang Xiu came out. His face was pale and there were beads of sweat on his forehead. It seemed that his assessment results were not satisfactory.
"Next!"
Dr. Chen's old and gentle voice came from the room.
"Senior Brother Lin, I don't know whether you go first or I go first."
